description: Independent source-grounded editorial verification before any story becomes approved or generates paid media.
required_gates: No missing, stale, model-invented or unsupported evidence.
No approval if an exact quote does not occur in the trusted source snapshot.
At least two independent publisher groups for all material claims, otherwise human review.
Risk tier sensitive or unknown requires human approval.
All public-facing wording is version-bound; rewrite invalidates existing review.
A source's existence is not proof that it supports the claim. Independent semantic review is mandatory.
One editorial grade is not independent factual evidence.
No publish, paid generation, SQL mutation or account credential access in design-only mode.
release_dependencies: PR #585 quality fail-closed reviewed and deployed
controlled fact-check model routing and spend budget
review receipt database migration and auth RLS
publisher fail-closed admission and channel-by-channel tests
